description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing and retrieving Buy Down Fee amortization details related to loans in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for fetching amortization details by loan ID or external ID, and for retrieving Buy Down Fee allocation data by various identifiers.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing Buy Down Fee related endpoints in the loan portfolio.

methods.name: retrieveLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails
methods.description: Fetches amortization details of Buy Down fees for a specific loan by loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetailsByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches amortization details of Buy Down fees for a specific loan by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveBuyDownFeesAllocationData
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve Buy Down Fee allocation data based on various identifiers.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Fetches Buy Down Fee allocation data by loan external ID and transaction ID.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Fetches Buy Down Fee allocation data by loan ID and transaction external ID.

methods.name: getBuyDownFeesAllocationDataByExternalIds
methods.description: Fetches Buy Down Fee allocation data by external IDs for both loan and transaction.
